title: OpenAI Responds to the Controversy Over the ChatGPT Desktop Version Interface: Remove 'Work' Tab by the End of the Year

content_html:
After launching GPT-5.6, advanced voice features, Codex integration, and a new Work intelligent agent mode, OpenAI has restructured the ChatGPT desktop application into a "super app," but the new interface has sparked widespread discussion among users due to issues such as difficulty finding chat history and complex tabs. In response, OpenAI President Greg Brockman publicly acknowledged in an interview with the media that the current product experience "is indeed a bit messy" and stated that the team is continuously iterating and optimizing the design.

Brockman said that the current multi-tab layout is just a transitional solution, and OpenAI's long-term goal is to create a desktop experience without tabs and with a unified workspace. According to the plan, by the end of 2026, the standalone "Work" tab will be removed, and its intelligent agent capabilities will be seamlessly integrated into ChatGPT. Conversations, Codex coding tools, and autonomous intelligent agent tasks will run together on the same interface, reducing the complexity caused by windows and sidebars.

Although the interface adjustments have sparked controversy, OpenAI stated that this integration has significantly promoted the adoption of Codex. Brockman revealed that after Codex was integrated into the ChatGPT desktop version, the user base grew from 5 million to 10 million within just a few days. In response to the question of whether the growth was due to forced integration, he admitted that this factor did exist, but he believed that allowing more ordinary users to access AI intelligent agent capabilities would help unlock greater product value, making it worthwhile to accept some experience costs at an early stage.

This response shows that OpenAI is rapidly evolving ChatGPT toward an "AI super app," and while unifying chat, programming, and intelligent agent capabilities, how to balance feature expansion with product usability will become the focus of future versions.

content_html_zh:
在推出GPT-5.6、高级语音功能、Codex集成以及全新的Work智能代理模式后，OpenAI将ChatGPT桌面应用重组为“超级应用”，但新界面因聊天记录查找困难、选项卡复杂等问题引发了用户的广泛讨论。 对此，OpenAI 总裁 Greg Brockman 在接受媒体采访时公开承认，目前的产品体验“确实有点乱”，并表示团队正在不断迭代和优化设计。

Brockman 表示，当前的多选项卡布局只是一个过渡解决方案，OpenAI 的长期目标是创建没有选项卡且具有统一工作空间的桌面体验。 根据计划，到2026年底，独立的“工作”选项卡将被删除，其智能代理功能将无缝集成到ChatGPT中。 对话、Codex 编码工具和自主智能代理任务将在同一界面上一起运行，减少窗口和侧边栏带来的复杂性。

尽管界面调整引发了争议，但 OpenAI 表示，这种整合极大地促进了 Codex 的采用。 Brockman透露，Codex集成到ChatGPT桌面版后，短短几天内用户群就从500万增长到1000万。 在回答增长是否是强制整合的问题时，他承认这个因素确实存在，但他认为，让更多普通用户接触到AI智能代理能力，有助于释放更大的产品价值，早期接受一些体验成本是值得的。

这一回应表明，OpenAI正在将ChatGPT快速向“AI超级应用”发展，在统一聊天、编程和智能代理能力的同时，如何平衡功能扩展和产品可用性将成为未来版本的重点。
